title: TransactionReceived
description: A transaction instruction has been accepted and durably persisted. Emitted by transaction-service via the transactional outbox.

reference.description: Counterparty-supplied reference. Normalised before matching, never mutated in place.

amount.description: Decimal STRING, never a JSON number. JSON.parse yields an IEEE-754 double and would destroy the value at the browser boundary. See ADR-0009.
